title: AI Portfolio Assistant
subtitle: LLM + RAG companion for personal brands
description: An intelligent portfolio companion that answers visitor questions and recommends projects.
longDescription: Built an end-to-end AI assistant embedded in a portfolio experience. Visitors can ask about skills, case studies, and availability. The system uses retrieval-augmented generation over project docs, then streams natural answers with source citations.
highlights: Streaming chat UI with citation cards

title: Cloud Deploy Dashboard
subtitle: Unified AWS + GCP release console
description: One console for deploys, live metrics, and AI-suggested infrastructure fixes.
longDescription: Designed a dark operational dashboard that unifies deployment pipelines across AWS and Google Cloud with one-click rollbacks and AI reliability suggestions.

title: Motion Studio Landing
subtitle: High-craft marketing site for a design studio
description: Immersive scroll storytelling with cinematic motion and conversion-focused CTAs.
longDescription: A performance-focused marketing site with scroll-triggered scenes, custom cursors, and modular case-study layouts optimized for Core Web Vitals.

title: Neon Commerce
subtitle: Headless storefront with instant checkout
description: Lightning-fast product browsing with optimistic cart and edge-cached pages.
longDescription: A headless commerce experience using Next.js and edge caching. Includes animated product galleries, optimistic cart updates, and A/B-tested checkout flows.

title: Signal Analytics
subtitle: Realtime product analytics wall
description: Live charts and cohort insights for product teams.
longDescription: Realtime analytics dashboard with websocket streams, custom charting, and saved cohort views for growth and product teams.

title: Aura Design System
subtitle: Token-driven UI kit for multi-brand apps
description: Shared components, themes, and docs used across 6 products.
longDescription: Built a token-based design system with theming, accessibility presets, and Storybook documentation adopted by multiple product teams.

title: Pulse Chat
subtitle: Collaborative messaging with AI summaries
description: Team chat with threads, presence, and auto meeting notes.
longDescription: Realtime collaborative messaging with typing presence, thread summaries powered by LLMs, and searchable message history.

title: Orbit Maps
subtitle: Interactive geospatial explorer
description: Smooth map storytelling with clustered markers and routes.
longDescription: Geospatial storytelling app with clustered markers, animated routes, and narrative panels for travel and logistics brands.

title: Forge CMS
subtitle: Visual content studio for marketers
description: Drag-and-drop pages with live preview and role permissions.
longDescription: A visual CMS with block editing, live preview, scheduling, and fine-grained roles for marketing teams.

title: Vault Auth
subtitle: Passwordless auth microservice
description: Magic links, passkeys, and session hardening for SaaS apps.
longDescription: Auth service supporting magic links, WebAuthn passkeys, device trust, and session revocation APIs for multiple client apps.

title: Lumen Docs
subtitle: Beautiful docs with AI search
description: Docs site with semantic search and versioned guides.
longDescription: Documentation platform with MDX content, semantic search over embeddings, and version switcher for product releases.

title: Skyline Booking
subtitle: Appointment OS for premium studios
description: Scheduling, deposits, and client portals in one polished UI.
longDescription: Booking platform for studios with calendar sync, deposit payments, reminder automations, and a branded client portal.
